Great Year Gets Kim NL Most Valuable Player Award
He may have less experience than most of his Major League Baseball peers, but that didn't slow <Do-young Kim:player#53669> down at all in 2026.

At the age of 23, the <Seoul:team#403> shortstop has been named the winner of the National League Most Valuable Player Award.

He had a .429 batting average and a .501 on-base percentage this year. In 134 games he piled up 239 hits, 66 doubles, 6 triples, 67 home runs, 206 RBIs and 188 runs scored.

"I'm blown away by the season I was able to put together," he said. "I'm looking forward to trying to do it all again next year."

He received 32 first place votes, as a unanimous winner. <Hyeon-min Ahn:player#54137> of the <Seoul Yukies:team#403> finished second in voting, while <Shinho Ho:player#141875> of the <Seoul Yukies:team#403> finished third.
